intervals.note: See experiment:nexo interval note; no confirmed physical-construction start date sourced in this session. `start` (2018) is the date of the earliest dated nEXO design document found (the Pre-Conceptual Design Report), a lower bound not a true start date.
intervals.quote: A consortium of over 150 scientists and technologists from 31 institutions and eight countries are contributing to the design and construction of nEXO.

intervals.label: US-led project paused (listed by SNOLAB, December 2024)
intervals.note: Added 2026-10-25 as an annotation (kind phase; status stays `proposed`). SNOLAB Report, slides dated 26 May 2026, slide 26 'SNOLAB Cryopit Timeline' (read from the rendered slide): the first entry, dated 'Dec 2024', says "US led nEXO project was paused."; the next entries are XLZD approved as a conceptual design study at SNOLAB (August 2025) and Canadian scientists joining the XLZD collaboration (March 2026). The nEXO website (nexo.llnl.gov, undated) still says "The nEXO experiment is under development", and SNOLAB's 31 July 2026 talk lists 'nEXO 2.0' among illustrative future-project ideas that 'does not indicate SNOLAB approval or space allocation'. No source says the project was cancelled, so it is not recorded as `cancelled`. The date is the one printed on the SNOLAB slide; the pause's own announcement was not found.
intervals.quote: US led nEXO project was paused.

summary.plain: A proposed tank of five tonnes of liquid xenon, planned for a deep Canadian mine, designed to be much more sensitive than its predecessor EXO-200.
summary.technical: Proposed single-phase liquid-xenon TPC, 5 t of 136Xe enriched to ~90%, planned for the SNOLAB 2 km level; scales up the EXO-200 design by roughly 25x in xenon mass.
